1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. By means of the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the applicant has sought for a suitable direction to the learned M.M. Court No.8, Kanpur Nagar, to decide the proceedings of Criminal Case No.2357 of 2015, arising out of Case Crime No.366 of 2013, under Sections 498A, 323 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Mahila Thana, District- Kanpur Nagar, within time stipulated by this Court, which is pending before the aforesaid court.

entities.text: Police Station- Mahila Thana, District- Kanpur Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. It was submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is the informant of the aforesaid case, which is pending since the year 2015 but the trial has not commenced yet and charges are yet to framed.
It is stated that earlier the proceedings in respect of some of the accused persons were stayed but now there is no interim order in favour of the accused persons.
